sights.address: Jalan Merah Saga / Jalan Kechubong, Chip Bee Gardens, Singapore
sights.w: A mid-1950s military estate built to house British army personnel from Pasir Panjang, Tanglin and Alexandra — six blocks of flats, semi-detached houses and two shophouse rows that served as the soldiers' mess and billiard rooms. After the 1970s pull-out it became Holland V's quieter dining-and-gallery strip along Jalan Merah Saga.
sights.k: Heritage estate; cafés and restaurants along Jalan Merah Saga
